# BBQ NANNY 烧烤管家

> One-stop BBQ supplies delivery in Malaysia. 马来西亚一站式烧烤食材与用品配送：冷冻烤串、丸子鱼饼、涮肉片、火锅汤底、烧烤架、卡式炉、黑炭、调味刷酱、一次性用品。WhatsApp 下单，巴生谷次日送达，全马冷冻快递。

- Website: https://bbqnanny.com/
- Order / WhatsApp: https://wa.me/60182560668 (+60 18-256 0668)
- Company: Oriental Food Wholesale Sdn. Bhd. (1653595-A), 57 Jalan 5/116B, Jalan Kuchai Lama, 58200 Kuala Lumpur
- Delivery: Klang Valley next-day (free above RM 300); nationwide frozen courier 2–3 working days (free above RM 500)
- Payment: bank transfer / e-wallet, confirmed via WhatsApp
